notes.subject: וקוי
notes.rationale: קוה is 'wait/hope (twist toward)'; Bambara 'jan' (await) is the nearest plain verb

notes.subject: יחליפו כח
notes.rationale: 'renew' vs 'exchange/pass on to' strength — Hebrew חלף means to pass/replace; Bambara lasigi kura follows the majority 'renew'

notes.subject: נשר
notes.rationale: eagle/vulture ambiguity in Hebrew נשר; Bambara nisongobila chooses the large soaring bird

notes.subject: olu minw bɛ Yawe jan
notes.rationale: verse holds out a promise to the waiting ones, continuing the direct summons of Isaiah 40

translation: Nka olu minw bɛ Yawe jan, Yawe bɛ u seko lasigi kura; olu na to nga i n'a fɔ nisongobila ye; olu bɛna ʝogɔndon, u tɛ na gɛlɛya; olu bɛna taa, u tɛ na lasara.
